Add a copy of the JavaScript library from the ISV to the solution along with MyBusinessLogic.
Add the code from the third-party JavaScript library to MyBusinessLogic. Add MyBusinessLogic to the solution.
Add only the third-party JavaScript web resource to the solution.

questions.explanation:
A managed solution must contain all JavaScript needed by MyBusinessLogic when the target environment might not contain the ISV solution. The third-party code can be deployed as a separate JavaScript web resource in the same solution as MyBusinessLogic, or it can be incorporated directly into MyBusinessLogic. JavaScript web-resource references are not automatically tracked as solution dependencies, so the required resource must be explicitly included in the deployable solution.

questions.question:
A user can access an existing Microsoft Dataverse database.  
  
You need to ensure the user can create canvas apps that consume Dataverse data. Do not grant any permissions beyond those required.  
  
Which out-of-the-box security role should you assign to the user?
questions.explanation:
The Environment Maker role is the least-privileged predefined role that permits creating canvas apps in an environment, including canvas apps that connect to Dataverse. Access to specific Dataverse tables still depends on the applicable data permissions.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a canvas app for a sales team. The app includes an embedded Power BI tile that displays year-to-date sales. Sales users do not have access to the data source used by the tile.  
  
Sales team users must be able to view the data in the Power BI tile. You must minimize both the permissions granted and administrative overhead.  
  
You need to share another Power BI component to make the data visible.  
  
What should you share?

options.text: The Power BI dataset the tile uses as a data source.
The Power BI workspace that includes the tile.
The Power BI dashboard that includes the tile.

questions.explanation:
A Power BI tile control in a canvas app requires users to be granted access to the dashboard that contains the tile; otherwise, the Power BI content will not display. Solution: Configure table permissions.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages table permissions control access to Dataverse table records and can be associated with web roles, privileges, and relationship-based access scopes. They can therefore allow managers to create and update stock information only for records belonging to their own store. [Set table permissions in Power Pages | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/table-permissions)\
\
**Learn more:** [Set table permissions in Power Pages | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/table-permissions)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
Solution: Use authentication with Microsoft Entra ID.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Microsoft Entra ID provides authentication, but it does not by itself authorize access to Dataverse stock records or limit a manager to records for one store. Power Pages enforces data access through table permissions associated with web roles, including an appropriate record-access scope and create/update privileges.\
\
**Learn more:** [Power Pages security](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/power-pages-security) · [Configure table permissions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/table-permissions)

questions.question:
Solution: Configure permissions for the page.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Page permissions restrict access to Power Pages content, not the ability to create, update, or limit access to specific Dataverse stock records. Store-specific stock entry and updates require table permissions with the appropriate privileges and record-level scope, assigned through web roles.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set page permissions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/page-security) · [Set table permissions in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/table-permissions)

questions.question:
Solution: Use local authentication.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Power Pages local authentication uses a local contact membership account with site-specific credentials, not the managers’ corporate identities. Corporate sign-in requires configuring an external identity provider, such as Microsoft Entra ID; store-specific create and update access must also be enforced through appropriate web roles and table permissions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of authentication in Power Pages](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/authentication/) · [Local authentication, registration, and other settings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/authentication/set-authentication-identity)

You have a canvas app.  
  
The canvas app must store data in a variable that is available only on the current screen.  
  
You need to create the variable.  
  
Which two functions should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Context variables are scoped to a single screen. `UpdateContext` creates or updates a context variable on that screen, and `Navigate` can establish context variables for the screen being displayed. `Set` and `Collect` create app-scoped storage rather than screen-scoped variables.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understand variables in canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/working-with-variables) · [UpdateContext function](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/reference/function-updatecontext)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You use the Data import wizard to import records into the account table from a CSV file.  
  
The CSV-to-table mapping is as follows:  
  
- The **Name** column represents the account name and maps to the **Account Name** column.  
- The **Parent Name** column represents the holding company of the account, with subsidiaries beneath it.

You need to configure the import to create the relationship between the records.

options.text: Map Parent Name in the CSV file to the Parent Account column. Select Account Name as the lookup criteria.
Map Parent Name in the file to the Parent Account column. Select Parent Account as the lookup criteria.
Create an alternate key on the account table by using the Account Name column. Do not map Parent Name in the file.
Look up the record IDs of the records in the Parent Account column. Add the record IDs as a new column in the file. Map the new column to the Parent Account column.

Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Question node stores the identified response in an output variable, and condition branches can compare a numeric variable with values or ranges to route the conversation. Capturing age and branching on the specified age ranges therefore enables the chatbot to determine the customer’s age group.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with variables - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-variables) · [Add conditions to topics - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-using-conditions)

Solution: Set **Identify** in the question to **Date and time**, and then add branches that use conditional logic to determine the age group.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Age is a numeric value that must be evaluated against the specified numeric ranges. The Date and time entity captures a calendar date/time value rather than a respondent’s age, so it cannot directly support the required age-group comparisons. Microsoft Copilot Studio provides distinct built-in entities for Number and Date and time.\
\
**Learn more:** [Implement slot-filling best practices - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/guidance/slot-filling-best-practices) · [Accommodate time zones - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/manage-date-and-time)

Solution: Create a custom **Age group** entity, with synonyms for every individual age in its corresponding item. Use **Age group** for **Identify** in the question.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A closed-list custom entity can use synonyms to expand the accepted values for each item. Assigning individual ages as synonyms of their applicable age-group item lets the question recognize an entered age through the **Age group** entity and return the corresponding group value. A Question node can use a custom entity through its **Identify** setting.\
\
**Learn more:** [Implement slot-filling best practices - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/guidance/slot-filling-best-practices) · [Work with variables - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-variables)

Users must be able to see only the `address1` columns in the Account table.  
  
You need to ensure that other address columns are not visible to users when they create views and filters.  
  
What should you do?

**Background**

ADatum Corporation provides verification and investigation services used by insurance companies, law firms, and other organizations in the public sector. Services include verifying an individual’s background, qualifications, and specific scenarios that require an onsite visit.

The thorough work ADatum Corporation performs results in highly accurate cases with very little critical information missing. Because of these high-quality results, ADatum Corporation is quickly establishing itself as one of the best in the industry. In recent months, business has increased significantly, with most of the new business coming from high-profile companies and individuals.

Management has decided to create a new qualification verification (QV) role to help ensure that clients receive the most accurate results. This role reviews completed work to ensure that nothing is missed.

**Current environment**

**Data storage and retention**

- All information sent by clients for services is stored in Microsoft Dataverse with a model-driven app as the interface.
- Clients enter their data on a website, which then uses a service account to create the records in the Dataverse database.
- Team members currently have full access to all Service Request records.

**Service requests**

- The Service Request table contains header information about the individual or organization that is the subject of verification.
- New Service Request records are assigned to a queue. All potential users who will be performing the verifications have access to these records.
- A service request is assigned to a single user who will ensure that all qualifications are verified. This single user is the only one able to process Qualification records related to their own service requests.
- Many required tasks when performing verification services are currently completed by using manual processes.
- To keep up with demand, ADatum Corporation identifies several processes that can be replaced by using Power Automate flows to hire fewer new staff and keep costs down.

**Qualification verification**

- The qualification table contains details about an individual school degree, professional qualifications, and other qualifications that must be verified.
- A service request can have one or more Qualification records associated with it.
- Record status is pending verification until the initial team member finishes, at which point the member changes the status to Complete.
- When all qualification records related to a service request are verified either by manual or automated processes, the results are made available to ADatum Corporation’s client.
- In the rare event that results are questioned, a new service request is created and verified independently of the previous work that took place.
- To complete a service request, users perform the following actions:
  - Send a templated email by using Microsoft Outlook to the client after all qualifications for a service request are checked.
  - Change the service request status to Completed.

Currently, service requests do not indicate when all Qualification records are addressed.

**Microsoft Power platform environment**

- The following environments exist: development, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production.
- Managed solutions are used to move customizations from the development environment to other higher-level environments. These solutions are created and maintained by the power users and provided to internal IT for deployment when they are ready.
- Two managed solutions, Verification Process Automation and Onsite Visit, share several components.
- All customizations to Power Platform components are performed by several power users who have received training and are certified as subject matter experts.
- Power users have been granted the System Administrator security role in the development environment.
- Corporate policy prohibits power users from writing code due to lack of a formal code review process.
- Internal IT will not be able to supply any development resources for this project due to a lack of staff. This means that any customizations and automation created for this project must be low-code/no-code for the power users to implement them.
- Customizations created by power users are deployed by internal IT.

**Requirements**

**Process automation**

ADatum Corporation plans to establish a new QV department to verify completed work so that the quality of work is maintained. The new process for verifying professional qualifications must automate the following:

- Enter data and navigate the authority’s website. The authority website UI changes frequently because the company constantly improves the user experience.
- Search page contents for a specified value to determine validity.
- Update the corresponding Qualification record in Dataverse.

The new process for completing a service request must automate the following:

- Set the Service Request record status to Complete when work on all Qualification records is finished.
- Send an email to the client with the results when the service request is completed. The email must list each qualification as either Valid or Not Valid, depending on the verification.

**Qualification verification**

- Service request results will not be released to clients until all related Qualification records are set to a Complete status.
- To check work done by a wide array of users, 10 percent of Qualification records must be double checked.
- Qualification records must be automatically assigned to a queue.
- Qualification records must be flagged with a new status field named Assigned to ensure that records are rechecked.
- Ensure that only QV team members can change the status from Assigned to In Progress to Complete.
- Record the name of the QV team member who performed the work and the date completed.

**Governance and security**

- All components required for the verification process must be included in a new solution.
- Corporate security requires that deployments to non-development environments must be automated using service accounts.
- User security and data access must also be consistent across environments, except for the elevated access of the power users in the development environment.
- The Onsite Visit managed solution has a table that is not in the Verification Process Automation managed solution. This table must be upgraded before the go-live date without the other shared components.
- A VP of sales requires a test environment to demonstrate to potential clients the security policies that are included in their initial offering.

**Issues**

- More employees than are required can access individual client information and continue to have access after a service request is completed.
- When users go on vacation, all their outstanding Service Request records are assigned to a substitute employee. The substitute employees are unable to see all the qualifications related to their service requests.
- Currently, testing the new QV functionality outside the development environment is not possible due to corporate security policies requiring the same security role across all environments.

You notice that the chatbot cannot recognize users’ questions.

A Power Apps gallery displays multiple records from a data source and can be configured through its Items property to sort records. Controls in the gallery template can use visibility logic to expand or hide subtopic content, making a gallery suitable for an interactive categorized record list.\
\
**Learn more:** [Gallery control in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-gallery) · [Show, sort, and filter data in a canvas app gallery](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/show-images-text-gallery-sort-filter)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a Power Apps app.  
  
The app must be able to show a list of records sorted by category. It must also be able to expand or hide the list by subtopics.  
  
You need to configure the app.  
  
Which tool should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Custom API can encapsulate complex Dataverse business logic in a plug-in, expose request and response parameters, and be called through Dataverse and Power Automate. A global Custom API is not restricted to a single table, making it suitable for logic that spans multiple tables while returning a result to the caller.

**Learn more:** [Create and use custom APIs (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/custom-api) · [CustomAPI tables (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/custom-api-tables)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are developing a new business process flow to qualify leads.  
  
You create an action, but it is not available within the Action Step. You need to make the action available to the Action Step.  
  
Which two steps must you take? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Ensure that the entity for the action matches the corresponding entity for the business process flow stage.
Add at least one step to the action.
Select Run as an on-demand process.

questions.explanation:
An action used by a business process flow must be associated with the same entity/table as the business process flow. An action must be activated before it can be executed and made available to processes. The on-demand setting is a workflow requirement, not an action requirement.

**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/create-business-process-flow) · [Create your own actions (Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/developer/create-own-actions?view=op-9-1)

questions.domain: Manage environments
questions.question:
You must configure the Deposit column.  
  
How should the formula be written?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse formula columns require a currency column to be converted by using `Decimal` before it is used in an expression. Multiplying `Decimal('Adoption Fee')` by `0.20` calculates the required 20% deposit. [Work with formula columns — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/formula-columns)\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with formula columns — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/formula-columns)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
You need to establish adoption duties for the administrative staff.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
A business process flow guides users through a defined, ordered set of stages and steps in a model-driven app. It can display the Commitment, Pre-pickup, and Pickup duties and lead administrative staff through them in sequence. [Business process flows overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/business-process-flows-overview)\
\
**Learn more:** [Business process flows overview — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/business-process-flows-overview)

questions.domain: Manage environments
questions.question:
You need to establish adoption duties for the administrative staff.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: Create two duplicate detection rules and two duplicate detection jobs, and update duplicate detection settings.
Create two duplicate detection rules and one duplicate detection job.
Create one duplicate detection rule and one duplicate detection job, and update duplicate detection settings.

questions.explanation:
A Dataverse duplicate detection rule supports multiple match conditions combined with logical AND, so one Contact rule can require both the same email address and the same last name. One scheduled duplicate detection job can run weekly. Organization duplicate-detection settings can disable duplicate prompts during record creation or update while allowing the scheduled job to identify duplicates.

**Learn more:** [Duplicate rule tables (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/duplicaterule-entities) · [Run bulk system jobs to detect duplicate records](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/run-bulk-system-jobs-detect-duplicate-records)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You need to enhance the user experience for care staff when they log exercise and feeding.  
  
What should you create?

options.text: Custom page in a model-driven app

questions.explanation:
A custom page adds a canvas-style experience inside a model-driven app, allowing a touch-friendly layout with appropriately sized controls while keeping the solution within the single required model-driven app. Custom pages provide more layout and component flexibility than model-driven forms and are part of the model-driven app rather than a separate standalone canvas app.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of custom pages for model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/model-app-page-overview) · [Add a custom page to your model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/add-page-to-model-app)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
A company is deploying Microsoft Power Platform solutions.  
  
The company requests details about the capabilities supported by Power Fx.  
  
You need to identify Power Fx features.  
  
What should you identify?

options.text: It uses imperative and declarative logic.
It uses an undefined value for uninitialized variables.
It uses the model-driven app formula language.

questions.explanation:
Power Fx uses the same expression language for declarative spreadsheet-like formulas and imperative logic needed for app behaviors and state changes. It does not use an `undefined` value for uninitialized variables; such values are handled as blank or errors. [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/power-platform/power-fx/overview)\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/power-platform/power-fx/overview)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You are designing a Power Virtual Agents chatbot.  
  
The chatbot must retain customer information when the conversation topic changes during a dialog. You need to configure variables to store the customer's name and email address.  
  
Which type of variable should you create?
questions.explanation:
Bot variables are global variables that can be accessed from any topic and retain their values throughout the user session. They therefore preserve the customer's name and email address when the conversation changes topics during a dialog.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with global variables - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-sg/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-variables-bot)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You need to capture the **Date Completed** value from a website by using a desktop flow.  
  
Which method should you use?

options.text: Use optical character recognition (OCR) on the screen to locate and extract the value.
Display an input dialog and prompt the user to enter the value.
Extract the value from the window the browser is using.
Retrieve the value from the HTML element in the webpage.

questions.explanation:
Power Automate desktop flows can retrieve an attribute or text value directly from a selected web-page UI element through browser automation. This captures the structured value from the webpage rather than relying on image-based OCR or manual input.\
\
**Learn more:** [Browser automation actions reference - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/power-automate/desktop-flows/actions-reference/webautomation)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company has marketing teams in different regions.  
  
A user creates and publishes a chatbot in Microsoft Teams for their specific marketing team. The base metrics that the chatbot retrieves apply to all marketing teams. The other marketing teams request access to the chatbot.  
  
You need to publish the chatbot across the entire company.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Configure the chatbot to be used with the Teams channel.
Submit the chatbot for admin approval.
Copy the published chatbot link and email it to the other teams.
Invite the other teams to the team that has the chatbot.
Export the chatbot and import it into a corporate environment.

questions.explanation:
Organization-wide distribution of a Copilot Studio chatbot in Microsoft Teams requires submitting it for administrator approval so it can be made available through the organization's Teams app store. This enables the administrator to manage availability for the whole organization or selected users.

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a Microsoft Teams Power Apps app that uses Microsoft Dataverse for Teams.  
  
Users report that they cannot view the app in Teams.  
  
You need to make sure that users can access the app.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Share the app with a security group by using the Maker portal.
Publish the app by using the Maker portal.
Request that a tenant administrator pin the app to the app bar in Teams.
Share the app with a security group in Teams.
Share the app with individual users by using the Maker portal.

questions.explanation:
Power Apps apps built in Teams with Dataverse for Teams are shared through the Power Apps app in Teams. Sharing the app with a Microsoft Entra security group in Teams grants the group access and makes the app available to its members; publishing or pinning an app does not itself grant user authorization.

**Learn more:** [Set permission and share apps with colleagues](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/teams/set-perms-and-share) · [Granting permission to tables in Dataverse for Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/teams/dataverse-for-teams-table-permissions)

questions.domain: Manage environments
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must create a new entity that supports a new app feature. Entity records must be associated with a business unit and define security roles for that business unit.  
  
You need to configure entity ownership.  
  
Which entity ownership type should you use?
questions.explanation:
User or team-owned records support the business-unit security model: the record owner is a user or team associated with a business unit, and access can be controlled through security-role privileges at the business-unit level. For newly created Dataverse tables, the supported ownership choices are Organization or User or Team; business-owned is not a selectable creation option.

**Learn more:** [Table definitions in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/entity-metadata) · [Assign security roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/assign-security-roles)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a report by using Power BI Desktop and a Power BI dataset connected to Azure SQL Database.  
  
Multiple employee groups will use the report.  
  
You need to ensure that each employee group can view only the data that applies to its group.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create and assign field security profiles.
Create and assign Common Data Service security roles.
Create and assign roles by using row-level security.

questions.explanation:
Power BI row-level security (RLS) restricts access to subsets of semantic-model data by applying row filters within roles. Users or security groups can be assigned to the appropriate RLS roles, ensuring each employee group sees only the rows relevant to that group.\
\
**Learn more:** [Row-level security (RLS) with Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/security/service-admin-row-level-security)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company is deploying Power Apps and Power Automate.  
  
Several components are created in Power Apps, Microsoft Dataverse, and Power Automate. The components must be promoted from the development environment to the user acceptance test environment in one solution package.  
  
You need to create the solution package for promotion.  
  
Where should the package be created?
questions.explanation:
Power Platform solutions package app, Dataverse, and flow components for export and import between environments. Solutions are created from the **Solutions** area in the Power Apps maker portal. [Microsoft Learn: Create a solution](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-solution)\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a solution - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-solution)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a Power Virtual Agents chatbot to reduce the number of incoming support calls that require a live person.  
  
The chatbot does not guide users to the correct information. You determine that this occurs because the chatbot cannot identify which product a user refers to during a conversation.  
  
You need to display a list of products so users can select the correct product.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
A custom closed-list entity defines a predefined set of values, such as product names, that the chatbot can recognize and use to capture the product selected by a user. Slot filling uses entities to gather information, while variables store the resulting value.\
\
**Learn more:** [Implement slot-filling best practices — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/guidance/slot-filling-best-practices)

A company uses Power Apps.  
  
The company intends to create a canvas app that uses a responsive design.  
  
You need to configure the app.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Disable the Scale to fit setting.
Configure the height and width properties by using drag handles.
Configure the height and width properties by using a formula.

questions.explanation:
A responsive canvas app must have **Scale to fit** disabled so it can adapt to the device or window dimensions. Its controls’ Height and Width properties should use Power Fx formulas, such as references to Parent or App dimensions, so their sizes adjust dynamically. Fixed sizing through drag handles does not provide responsive behavior, and orientation must not be locked for the layout to adapt to orientation changes.

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You must configure the new service-request completion process.  
  
Which two components should be included in the solution? Each correct answer provides part of the complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A business process flow defines and guides users through the stages of a business process. A Power Automate flow automates the actions and logic associated with service-request completion. Connection references only provide portable connector configuration for solution-aware flows; they do not implement the process itself.

**Learn more:** [Create a business process flow in Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/create-business-process-flow) · [Use a connection reference in a solution with Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-connection-reference)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is implementing advanced capabilities for a Power Pages website.  
  
The company stores documents and lists across several SharePoint environments hosted both on-premises and online. Power Pages site users must be able to view, search, and filter this data through one intuitive experience.  
  
You need to determine which advanced feature to implement.  
  
What should you implement?
questions.explanation:
Virtual tables expose data from external systems as Dataverse tables without replicating it, allowing Power Pages to work with that data through its standard table-based experience. SharePoint is a supported virtual-table connector source. SharePoint document management is limited to SharePoint Online and is intended for documents related to Dataverse records, while progressive search only refines Power Pages search-result behavior.

**Learn more:** [Create and modify virtual tables by using the Data workspace](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/configure/data-workspace-virtual-tables) · [Manage SharePoint documents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/configure/manage-sharepoint-documents)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company intends to send escalation emails to every customer with overdue invoices. You are building a Microsoft Power Automate flow to decide whether an escalation email should be sent.  
  
The system must issue an alert for every invoice that is overdue by seven days or more.  
  
You need to configure the flow.  
  
Which expression should you use?
questions.explanation:
The `greaterOrEquals` workflow expression function returns `true` when its first value is greater than or equal to its comparison value. Comparing the overdue value from the trigger to `7` therefore identifies invoices overdue for at least seven days, including exactly seven days.

**Learn more:** [Use expressions in conditions in Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/use-expressions-in-conditions) · [Reference guide to workflow expression functions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/logic-apps/expression-functions-reference)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are creating a model-driven app. Advanced settings are enabled in the environment.  
  
A form in the app needs a custom interface.  
  
You must embed the custom interface on the form without using custom code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a canvas app and bind its properties to the form.
Modify the model-driven app to use tablet form factor.

questions.explanation:
An embedded canvas app provides a custom low-code interface on a model-driven form and can receive contextual form data through bound properties. Microsoft documents that canvas apps can be embedded on model-driven forms as custom controls and support integration with host-form data.

**Learn more:** [Embed a canvas app on a model-driven form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embed-canvas-app-in-form) · [Add an embedded canvas app on a model-driven app form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embedded-canvas-app-add-classic-designer)

A company is deploying Microsoft Power Platform solutions.  
  
The company requests information about the features supported by Power Fx.  
  
You need to identify the features of Power Fx.  
  
What should you identify?

options.text: It is available for purchase through a Microsoft reseller.
It uses an undefined value for uninitialized variables.
It uses formulas that are similar to Microsoft Excel formulas.

questions.explanation:
Power Fx is a low-code formula language that borrows heavily from the Microsoft Excel formula language, so it uses Excel-like formulas. [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/overview)\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/overview)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
A company is deploying Microsoft Power Platform solutions.  
  
The company requests information about the features supported by Power Fx.  
  
You need to identify the features of Power Fx.  
  
What should you identify?

options.text: Create an autonumber column on the Qualification table and assign its qualification records if the number cleanly divides by 10.

Create a calculated column on the Service Request table that sums the number of qualification records, generates a random number between zero and the number from the new field, and assigns each qualification record if the number generated is 10 percent or less of the value of the new field.

Create a roll-up column on the Service Request table that is the count of qualification records, generates a random number between zero and the number from the new field, and assigns each qualification record if the number generated is 10 percent or less of the value of the new field.
Create an autonumber column on the Service Request table and assign its qualification records if the number cleanly divides by 10.

questions.explanation:
An autonumber column on the Qualification table generates a sequential value for each individual Qualification record. Routing records whose sequential number is divisible by 10 sends every tenth record to the QV queue, producing a deterministic 10 percent allocation. Dataverse autonumber columns can be added to a table and generate values automatically when rows are created.

**Learn more:** [Autonumber columns in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/autonumber-fields) · [Create autonumber columns (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/create-auto-number-attributes)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You intend to add a Power Apps app to Microsoft Teams.  
  
A Microsoft Dataverse for Teams environment has not yet been provisioned.  
  
You need to create a Dataverse for Teams environment.  
  
Which two actions can you take? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create a new app in Teams.
Install an existing app in Teams.
Create a new environment in the Microsoft Power Platform Admin Center.
Create an app permission policy in the Teams admin center.

questions.explanation:
A Dataverse for Teams environment is automatically provisioned for the selected team when a user creates a Power Apps app in Teams for the first time, or installs a Power Apps-created app from the Teams app catalog for the first time. A standard environment created in the Power Platform admin center is not a Dataverse for Teams environment, and an app permission policy only controls app availability and permissions.

**Learn more:** [Create apps in Microsoft Teams by using Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/teams/create-apps-overview)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a classic workflow that updates a custom column on a record when an account record is created.  
  
The workflow must update the custom-column value under these conditions:  
  
- Update the custom-column value by using the Account Number.  
- If the Account Number column is blank, update the custom-column value by using the Ticker Symbol.  
- If the Ticker Symbol column is blank, update the custom-column value to N/A.  
  
You need to configure the custom-column value by using the update-record step.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Add a formula that evaluates the two column values and uses the first populated value or else the default value.
Add an expression that evaluates the two column values and uses the first populated value or else the default value.
Add the two columns with the default value by using the Forms Assistant.
Add check conditions to determine if the two columns contain data.

questions.explanation:
Classic Dataverse workflow Check Conditions provide if-then branching and include the Contains Data and Does Not Contain Data operators. Branching on whether Account Number and then Ticker Symbol contain data implements the required ordered fallback; each branch can use an Update Record action to set the appropriate value, including N/A when both are blank.

**Learn more:** [Configure a workflow in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (on-premises)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customerengagement/on-premises/customize/configure-workflow-steps?view=op-9-1)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Solution: Enable integration with Outlook.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Outlook integration is for working with and tracking Outlook emails, appointments, contacts, and tasks in Dynamics 365; it does not provide a document repository for customer records. SharePoint integration provides document management and stores the documents in SharePoint, which is the relevant approach for avoiding additional Dynamics 365 storage consumption.\
\
**Learn more:** [Do your Dynamics 365 apps work in Outlook using Dynamics 365 for Outlook](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/outlook-addin/user-guide/dynamics-365-work-outlook) · [Manage your documents using SharePoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/manage-documents-using-sharepoint)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Enable server-based integration with SharePoint.  
  
Does this accomplish the goal?
questions.explanation:
Server-based SharePoint integration enables documents to be stored and managed in SharePoint in the context of customer records, rather than consuming additional Dataverse/Dynamics 365 storage. This supports attaching many supporting documents while keeping application storage costs low.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up SharePoint integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/set-up-sharepoint-integration) · [Set up customer engagement apps to use SharePoint Online](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/set-up-dynamics-365-online-to-use-sharepoint-online)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
Solution: Enable OneDrive for Business.  
  
Does this satisfy the goal?
questions.explanation:
OneDrive for Business is a Microsoft 365 service rather than the Dynamics 365 document-management integration used to associate documents with customer records. SharePoint integration is the supported approach for storing and managing documents related to Dataverse/Dynamics 365 records, and it requires the relevant Microsoft 365 integration to be configured.\
\
**Learn more:** [Manage documents using SharePoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/manage-documents-using-sharepoint)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Solution: Enable integration with OneNote.  
  
Does this meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
OneNote integration is for taking and reviewing customer notes, not for document storage. It also requires server-based SharePoint integration and a Microsoft 365 subscription, so it cannot meet the stated storage objective when Office 365 application integrations are not enabled.\
\
**Learn more:** [Set up OneNote integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/power-platform/admin/set-up-onenote-integration-in-dynamics-365)

A company is building several Power Virtual Agents chatbots. The company manufactures more than 1,000 distinct products.  
  
The chatbots must ask users to enter or choose a product.  
  
You need to store the product information so it can be reused across all chatbots.  
  
Where should the model data be stored?
questions.explanation:
Custom entities represent domain-specific values, including predefined closed lists, that can be used to recognize and collect a product value in chatbot conversations. lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You develop a model-driven app with an embedded Power BI report in the development environment.  
  
Another environment has a Power BI workspace corresponding to the development environment.  
  
All deployments must occur by using the maker portal.  
  
When you manually deploy changes to the other environment, you notice that the report from the development workspace is displayed.  
  
You need to fix the issue.  
  
Which two actions should you take? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Replace the Report component with a Power BI Dashboard component.
Include the current value in the solution.
Remove the current value in the solution.

questions.explanation:
Power BI embedded components can use environment variables to configure the workspace and report separately for each environment. Removing the environment variable’s current value from the solution prevents the development value from being exported, while retaining it in development and allowing a target-environment value to be provided during solution import.

**Learn more:** [Create or edit a Power BI embedded system dashboard](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-powerbi-embedded-page) · [Use environment variables in Power Platform solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/environmentvariables)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a Power Apps portal that provides training and documentation to students. Students create a profile in the portal and then choose and pay for courses.  
  
You plan to add free courses to the training portfolio. Free courses must automatically be available to every student after they sign in.  
  
You need to assign default permissions to students.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a Students web role and set the Authenticated Users Role option to true. Assign the web role to each registered user.

Create an entity for managing free courses. Create entity permission records to provide access to entity records for free courses and assign the entity permissions to users when they register on the portal for the first time.

Create an entity for managing free courses. Create a Students web role and set the Authenticated Users role option to true. Create appropriate entity permissions to access the free course entity records and assign the entity permissions to the web role.

Associating entity permissions for the free-course entity with that role grants all signed-in students the required access to those records. Entity permissions are assigned to web roles, which provide the permissions to users.

/>","className":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Dataverse together with a model-driven app that includes a table named Quotations.  
  
Users enter relevant details into this table, such as:  

- Customer  
- Address  
- Line items  
- Total amounts  
  
Users then manually create a standardized report to populate these details.  
  
The company wants the formatted report to instead be automatically generated from the record and populated with the record's details, without purchasing any additional licenses.  
  
You need to recommend a solution.  
  
Which solution should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse includes a native Word template capability for model-driven apps that lets users download a template tied to a table (including related one-to-many data such as line items), map the fields using content controls in Word's Developer/XML Mapping pane, and then generate a fully populated, standardized Word document directly from an individual record with a single click. This works out of the box with an existing Dataverse/model-driven app license, requiring no custom code, Power Automate flows, or additional purchased licenses. Excel templates, in contrast, are designed to export and analyze a list of multiple records (e.g., for reporting/analysis across many rows), not to populate a single formatted document from one record. Article templates apply only to Knowledge Base (Knowledge Article) authoring in Dynamics 365 Customer Service and prepopulate fields like title, keywords, and language for articles — they are unrelated to generating a report from a custom table record like Quotations.

**Learn more:** [Use Word templates to create standardized documents - Power Platform | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/using-word-templates-dynamics-365) · [Work with Excel and Word templates - Power Apps | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/templates-overview)

You need to import the leads without altering the partner company’s data.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Create a data map on the first import by using the Import Data wizard.
Add a template for Import Data.
Create a data map in Data Management.

questions.explanation:
A data map defines how source-file columns map to Dataverse table fields. When source field names do not match and no suitable map exists, the Import Data wizard allows the fields to be mapped during the import and those settings to be saved as a new data map for future use, without changing the source data.

The existing solution is in English, and its customized components must be translated into several languages.  
  
You need to export the text for translation.  
  
In which location can you accomplish this goal?

The selected environment in the Microsoft Power Platform admin center.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You plan to create user interface (UI) flows that automate several web-based business processes you currently carry out manually.  
  
You must ensure that users can create and run web UI flows.  
  
Which three components must you install and configure on users' devices? Each correct answer presents part of the solution.  
  
> NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Legacy Power Automate web UI flows require the Power Automate Desktop/UI flows application, Selenium IDE, and the latest Chromium-based Microsoft Edge browser. Selenium IDE provides the web-interaction recording and playback capability; the gateway is for cloud-to-machine invocation rather than the local authoring and execution components. Microsoft’s legacy RPA UI-flows documentation identifies Selenium IDE and the latest Chrome or Microsoft Edge as the supported web-automation stack.

**Learn more:** [Robotic Process Automation in Power Automate — Licensing FAQ](https://download.microsoft.com/download/3/D/4/3D42BDC2-6725-4B29-B75A-A5B04179958B/RPA_in_Power_Automate.pdf)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Solution: Embed a canvas app in the case form that dynamically displays knowledge articles based on the case category.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Embedded canvas apps on model-driven forms can receive contextual data from the host form and display data from connected sources alongside the form. A canvas app can use the case category to filter relevant knowledge articles, allowing agents to view contextual knowledge within the case form without refreshing the record.\
\
**Learn more:** [Embed a canvas app on a model-driven form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embed-canvas-app-in-form) · [Pass the current record as data context to an embedded canvas app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/pass-current-embedded-canvas-app)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Embed a canvas app in the case form that dynamically displays knowledge articles based on the case category.  
  
Does the solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
An instant flow that updates a Dataverse row changes stored record data but does not provide a form component that displays contextual knowledge to agents. Updating a row also does not itself refresh the open model-driven form; form data refresh is a separate client-side operation. [Microsoft Learn: Use a flow to update a row](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/update) and [data.refresh (Client API reference)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/clientapi/reference/formcontext-data/refresh).

**Learn more:** [Use a flow to update a row](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/update) · [data.refresh (Client API reference)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/model-driven-apps/clientapi/reference/formcontext-data/refresh)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Solution: Add a custom page containing a knowledge article lookup, and link to it by using a navigation button in the app.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Custom pages are separate model-driven app pages that users navigate to from the site map or by using navigation APIs. A navigation button to a custom page does not embed contextual knowledge in the active case form, so it does not meet a requirement to display that knowledge directly in the form without changing pages or refreshing the record.\
\
**Learn more:** [Overview of custom pages for model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/model-app-page-overview) · [Add a custom page to your model-driven app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/add-page-to-model-app)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
Solution: On the case form, add a subgrid that references a custom table used to store external article links.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A custom-table subgrid can show links, but it does not provide contextual knowledge retrieval or display article content inline in the case form. Dynamics 365 Customer Service’s Knowledge Base Search control is intended to suggest relevant knowledge while users work on a record and supports inline article viewing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add the Knowledge Base Search control to forms](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/administer/add-knowledge-base-search-control-forms) · [Search knowledge articles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/customer-service/use/search-knowledge-articles-csh)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company builds a bot by using Power Virtual Agents.  
  
The company requires the bot to transfer callers to an agent when the bot cannot recognize a customer’s request.  
  
You need to configure the bot for unrecognized information from the customer.  
  
Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
A fallback topic is triggered for an unknown intent or unrecognized user input. Its behavior can be customized to redirect the conversation and escalate it to a live agent.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure the system fallback topic](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-system-fallback-topic)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create and publish a Power BI report that includes an embedded canvas app. Multiple people will use the report.  
  
The canvas app has an issue that must be fixed. You update the canvas app.  
  
You need to make sure that the updated canvas app is available in the published Power BI report.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Manually refresh the data source on the published Power BI report
Publish the Power BI report from Power BI Desktop and reshare to any users
Publish the Power BI report from Power BI Desktop

questions.explanation:
Publishing a canvas app makes its latest saved changes available to the people with whom the app is shared. For the Power Apps visual in Power BI, changes to the canvas app are saved and published in Power Apps so that the updated app appears in the Power BI report.

**Learn more:** [Power Apps visual for Power BI](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/powerapps-custom-visual) · [Save and publish canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/save-publish-app)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company uses Dataverse.  
  
Users need a way to manually track emails from within Outlook against specific row types in the system.  
  
You need to recommend a solution.  
  
Which solution should you recommend?
questions.explanation:
Dynamics 365 App for Outlook lets users track Outlook email and use **Set Regarding** to associate it with an existing Dataverse row. It is the built-in solution for manual email tracking and row association from Outlook.\
\
**Learn more:** [Link and track an email or appointment to a specific row in your app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/outlook-app/user/track-message-or-appointment) · [Use Dynamics 365 App for Outlook](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/use-outlook-app)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company uses Dataverse.  
  
Users need a way to manually track emails from within Outlook against specific row types in the system.  
  
You need to recommend a solution.  
  
Which solution should you recommend?

options.text: Create a dynamic distribution list. Add all users to the distribution list and use the list to share the dashboard.
Sign into the Power BI service. Open the dashboard and select Share.
Enter the individual email address of internal and external users.
Sign into Power BI Desktop. Open the dashboard and select Share.
Clear the Allow recipients to share your dashboard (or report) option.
Create a distribution list. Add all users to the distribution list and use the list to share the dashboard.

questions.explanation:
Power BI dashboard sharing is done from the Power BI service by selecting **Share**. Direct sharing lets you enter individual internal and external (guest) email addresses, and the sharing dialog supports up to 100 separate users or groups. Clearing the reshare permission prevents recipients from sharing the dashboard with others. Dynamic distribution lists cannot be used to share dashboards, and distribution groups containing external email addresses are not appropriate for this purpose.

**Learn more:** [Share and Collaborate on Power BI Reports and Dashboards](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-share-dashboards) · [Troubleshoot sharing dashboards and reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-bi/collaborate-share/service-troubleshoot-sharing)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses Microsoft Teams and plans to create a Power Apps app for Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to identify the environment the app will use.  
  
Which environment will the app use?

options.text: An existing Dataverse environment that you select.
An existing Dataverse for Teams environment that you select.
A Dataverse environment that is automatically created for the team.
A Dataverse for Teams environment that is automatically created for the team.

questions.explanation:
Apps created in Microsoft Teams by using the Power Apps app are backed by a Dataverse for Teams environment. A Dataverse for Teams environment is automatically created for the selected team when needed, such as when its first Power Apps app is created.

questions.domain: Manage environments
questions.question:
Your organization prohibits using custom code for solutions.  
  
You need to create a view that all users in the organization can access.  
  
Where should you create the view?
questions.explanation:
A public view is available to app users and can be created and configured in Power Apps by opening a solution, opening the relevant table, and using its Views area. Advanced Find is used to create personal views, which are not organization-wide by default.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create and edit public or system views](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-or-edit-model-driven-app-view) · [Understand model-driven app views](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-views)

questions.domain: Manage environments
questions.question:
You need to add controls to the check-in solution for health and wellness questions.  
  
Which form control should be used?
questions.explanation: A check box control is suitable for capturing Boolean or applicable/not-applicable responses to health and wellness questions. It provides a clear selectable state without requiring free-form input.

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
You need to view questions and comments submitted through the website.  
  
Where should you view this information?
questions.explanation:
The Power Pages starter layout template's Contact Us page contains a feedback form that creates records in the Dataverse Feedback table. Website questions and comments should therefore be viewed in Feedback.\
\
**Learn more:** [Starter layout templates](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/templates/starter-layout)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
You need to create an evaluation record automatically for a prospect.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation: A real-time classic Dataverse workflow runs synchronously and can create the related Evaluation record before the operation completes, satisfying the requirement that users cannot proceed until that record has been created. A cloud flow runs asynchronously, while plug-ins require prohibited custom code and quick create forms are manual.

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You need to format the **Current Date** field for parental consent.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Power Automate expression can use `formatDateTime()` with a format such as `MMMM d, yyyy` to render the current date with the full month name, day, and year. [Microsoft Learn: Customize or format date and time values in a flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/date-time-values)\
\
**Learn more:** [Customize or format date and time values in a flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/date-time-values)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You need to store scanned consent forms.  
  
Where should the forms be stored?
questions.explanation:
SharePoint document management stores documents in SharePoint while allowing them to be managed in the context of Dataverse records. This avoids using Dataverse file storage for scanned consent documents, which satisfies the requirement to minimize Dataverse database and file storage costs.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use SharePoint and Dynamics 365 apps to manage your documents](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/manage-documents-using-sharepoint) · [Collaborate using SharePoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/collaborate-using-sharepoint)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You are creating tables for use with Microsoft Power Platform components.  
  
The tables’ display names must remain unchanged when the solution is promoted to the user acceptance testing environment.  
  
You need to enforce this restriction in the solution.  
  
Where should you make the changes?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse table managed properties can disable modification of a table’s display name. These properties are configured in the unmanaged solution in the development environment and take effect when the solution is packaged and imported as a managed solution into another environment.\
\
**Learn more:** [View and edit managed properties in solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/managed-properties-alm)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
You are building a canvas app.  
  
You need to apply business rules to the app without writing code.  
  
Which three actions can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Validate data and show error messages.

questions.explanation:
For canvas apps, Dataverse business rules can set column values, set column requirement levels, and validate data while displaying error messages. The show/hide and enable/disable actions are not available for canvas apps.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create a business rule in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-create-business-rule)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company is implementing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform.  
  
The company requests details about the features supported by Power Fx.  
  
You need to identify the features of Power Fx.  
  
What should you identify?

options.text: It uses an undefined value for uninitialized variables.
It uses formulas that are similar to Microsoft Excel formulas.
It uses the model-driven app formula language.

questions.explanation:
Power Fx uses formulas with syntax and behavior similar to Microsoft Excel formulas, including formulas that calculate values and automatically recalculate when their inputs change.\
\
**Learn more:** [Tables in Microsoft Power Fx](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/tables)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You try to deactivate multiple currencies in a Microsoft Dataverse environment.  
  
You cannot deactivate one of the currencies.  
  
You need to find out why the currency cannot be deactivated.  
  
What is the reason?

options.text: You are not the currency record owner.
The currency is used by an active business process.
The currency is the base currency.
The currency is used by another record.

questions.explanation:
A Dataverse environment’s base currency cannot be deactivated. Currencies referenced by other records can be deactivated, which retains their existing currency information but prevents their selection for new transactions.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Dataverse web service error codes](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/reference/web-service-error-codes) · [Manage transactions with multiple currencies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/manage-transactions-with-multiple-currencies)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create an app for a company's sales team.  
  
Sales team members are unable to access the app.  
  
You need to ensure that members of the sales team can access it.  
  
Where should you configure the app permissions?
questions.explanation:
Model-driven app access is granted by associating the appropriate security roles with the app. The **Manage Roles** setting configures which roles can use the app; members assigned to those roles can access it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Share a model-driven app - assigning security roles and privileges](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/share-model-driven-app)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
You create an app for a company's sales team.  
  
Sales team members are unable to access the app.  
  
You need to ensure that members of the sales team can access it.  
  
Where should you configure the app permissions?

options.text: Set the Optimized embedding appearance field to true.

questions.explanation:
Before exporting an unmanaged Power Apps solution, publish all changes because only published components are included in the export. Microsoft also recommends running Solution Checker during export to detect performance and stability issues.

**Learn more:** [Export solutions - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/export-solutions) · [Improve solution performance, stability, and reliability with solution checker - Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/use-powerapps-checker)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are creating a model-driven app in an environment where Advanced settings have been enabled.  
  
One of the forms in this app must include a custom interface.  
  
You need to embed this custom interface directly onto the form without writing any custom code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Modify the model-driven app to use mobile form factor.
Modify the model-driven app to use tablet form factor.
Use the classic experience to add a canvas app.

questions.explanation:
Embedding a canvas app onto a model-driven form lets you add a fully custom, WYSIWYG-designed interface to a form section without writing code. To add or create a canvas app control on a form, you must open the form in the classic form designer (via the 'Switch to classic' option), which is only available when the classic experience has been enabled through the environment's Advanced Settings. Once added, the canvas app control can be bound to form data via the ModelDrivenFormIntegration control, giving the embedded canvas app full read access to the host record's data — all without custom code. Quick view forms only display read-only data from related records and cannot host a custom interface, while changing the form factor (mobile/tablet) only affects how the standard form renders on different devices.

**Learn more:** [Add an embedded canvas app on a model-driven app form - Power Apps | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embedded-canvas-app-add-classic-designer) · [Embed a canvas app on a model-driven form - Power Apps | Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embed-canvas-app-in-form)
