You are building a model-driven app with an embedded Power BI report. Another functional consultant configured an environment variable for the report.  
  
You add the dashboard to a solution in the development environment, and then import the changes into a production environment as a managed solution.  
  
When you test the report, its data is the same as it was in the development environment. You delete the solution in production.  
  
You need to fix the development-environment issue before redeploying the solution.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Update the environment variable current value
Remove the environment variable current value.
Update the environment variable default value.

questions.explanation:
A defined current value overrides the default value and can be included in a solution during deployment. Removing the current value from the development solution keeps that environment’s value from being exported, allowing a production-specific value to be provided when the solution is imported.

**Learn more:** [Use environment variables in Power Platform solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/environmentvariables)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You configure and test a user interface (UI) flow, and you plan to run it as a scheduled flow.  
  
The UI flow must run on a Windows 10 device. As part of the process automation, the UI flow must sign in to the Windows 10 device by using the credentials of a user account named User1.  
  
You need to ensure that the flow runs during non-peak hours and does not require physical user intervention.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Ensure that the User1 account has an active user session on the device.
Ensure that all user sessions are signed out.
Ensure that there are no active user sessions on the device.
Ensure that all user sessions are signed out except for locked user sessions.

questions.explanation:
Unattended Power Automate desktop flows create and manage a Windows session by using the credentials configured in the connection. On Windows 10, the target machine must have all users signed out; active or locked Windows user sessions prevent unattended execution.

**Learn more:** [Run unattended desktop flows - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/desktop-flows/run-unattended-desktop-flows)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
You need to create a desktop flow in Power Automate.  
  
Which two methods can you use to create the flow? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Create models by using Microsoft Visio.

questions.explanation:
Power Automate for desktop supports creating flows by recording mouse and keyboard activity, which generates automation actions, or by manually adding prebuilt actions from the Actions pane to the flow workspace.\
\
**Learn more:** [Record desktop flows - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/desktop-flows/recording-flow) · [Configure actions and the actions pane - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/desktop-flows/actions-pane)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You develop functionality for a company. The functionality includes a Microsoft Dataverse table with a form used for data entry. The functionality will be distributed to other lines of business in the company, each of which has its own Dataverse environment.  
  
New forms must not be created for updates to the functionality to work correctly.  
  
You need to package the new functionality for distribution.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use a patch solution and disable the ability to create new forms for the table.
Use a managed solution and include only the needed form.
Use an unmanaged solution and include only the needed form.
Use a managed solution and disable the ability to create new forms for the table.

questions.explanation:
Managed solutions are appropriate for distributing controlled functionality to other Dataverse environments. A table’s managed properties include the **New forms can be created** setting, which can prevent downstream environments from creating additional forms and thereby preserve the expected update behavior.

**Learn more:** [View and edit managed properties in solutions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/managed-properties-alm) · [Create and design model-driven app forms in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-design-forms)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You need to design the chat solution to respond to Guest1’s inquiry.  
  
Which three components can you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
> **NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Variables retain a guest’s responses for reuse later in the same conversation. Smart match improves recognition of fuzzy or misspelled entity input, and synonyms explicitly map alternate terms to the same recognized value. Together, these features support repeated natural-language inquiries without requiring an agent handoff.

**Learn more:** [Work with variables - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-variables) · [The City of Montréal enhances citizen engagement with Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/guidance/case-studies/city-montreal-citizen-engagement)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company plans to build an app by using Power Apps.  
  
The company has the following requirements:  
  
- The app must be able to enter data into Microsoft SharePoint.  
- Users must be able to add the app to Microsoft Teams.  
  
You need to recommend the type of app to create.  
  
Which app type should you recommend?

options.text: model-driven app as a personal app
model-driven app as a tab app
canvas app as a personal app
Canvas app as a tab app

questions.explanation:
A canvas app can connect to Microsoft SharePoint to enter data into SharePoint lists, and it can be embedded in a Microsoft Teams channel as a tab app. A personal app is intended for an individual’s Teams experience rather than placement as a channel tab.

**Learn more:** [Embed a canvas app as a tab app in Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/teams/embed-teams-tab) · [Power Apps and Microsoft Teams integration overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/teams/overview)

questions.question:
You are creating tables to use with Microsoft Power Platform components.  
  
The tables’ display names must remain unchanged when the solution is promoted to the user acceptance testing environment.  
  
You need to apply this restriction to the solution.  
  
Where should you make these changes?
questions.explanation:
A table’s managed property, **Display name can be modified**, is configured in the unmanaged solution in the development environment. The restriction is enforced when that solution is deployed as a managed solution to another environment, such as UAT.\
\
**Learn more:** [View and edit managed properties in solutions - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/managed-properties-alm)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A customer uses a custom entity to track events.  
  
The custom entity contains a custom field for the event venue. The customer must be able to show events by venue in a calendar.  
  
You need to ensure that every event is displayed by venue in the calendar.  
  
To which component should you add a control?
questions.explanation:
The Calendar control is added to a table view. Its configuration binds fields from that view to calendar properties, allowing event rows from the custom entity to be shown and organized using the venue field.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add the calendar control to tables in model-driven apps with Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/add-calendar-control) · [Work with rows in the new calendar view in model-driven apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/calendar-view)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A veterinary office plans to use Power Platform to improve customer experiences. The customer creates canvas apps to manage appointments.  
  
In the client appointment form, a dropdown field lets clients select their type of pet. When a client selects the **Other** option, the veterinarian wants a text field to appear so that additional details can be entered.  
  
You need to create a dynamically visible field. What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A business rule can evaluate a condition such as the pet type being **Other** and apply a conditional action to show a related details field. Workflows execute automation after events, and business process flows control process stages rather than conditional field visibility. Current Power Apps documentation notes that the show/hide business-rule action is not available for canvas apps; in an actual canvas app, conditional visibility should be implemented with a Power Fx formula on the control's `Visible` property.

**Learn more:** [Create a business rule for a table](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-create-business-rule) · [Text Input modern control in canvas apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/modern-controls/modern-control-text-input)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are exporting a solution from a development environment that includes a form and a view for a custom table.  
  
When you try to import the solution into another environment, the import fails because dependencies are missing.  
  
You need to make sure the solution can be imported successfully.  
  
What should you do to fix the dependency errors?

options.text: Select Export as Unmanaged when exporting the solution.
Publish all customizations in the environment before exporting the solution.
Select Include all objects when adding the table to the solution.
Select Export as Managed when exporting the solution.

questions.explanation:

**Learn more:** [Use table segmentation in solutions in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/segmented-solutions-alm)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You need to design the email-registration process for the resort portal.  
  
Which solution should be used?

options.text: Default the invitation code from the email upon logging into the portal
Auto-populate the invitation code field on the sign in screen from the email link
Embed the invitation code in the email link URL
Send the customer their username and temporary password in the email link

questions.explanation:
Power Pages supports invitation-based registration through automated email. An invitation has a unique code and the email template provides a link to the site's invitation-redemption page; including the invitation code in that link enables the recipient to redeem the specific invitation and receive the configured access or roles.\
\
**Learn more:** [Invite contacts to your Power Pages site](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-pages/security/invite-contacts)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You intend to create a Power Virtual Agents bot.  
  
The bot must support single sign-on.  
  
You need to publish the bot.  
  
Which two locations should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Mobile app developed for iOS and Android
Website developed using pro developer tools

questions.explanation:
Single sign-on is supported for bots published to a Custom Website, including a website built with pro-developer tools, and to Microsoft Teams. SSO is not supported for Mobile App or Azure Bot Service channels.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configure-sso) · [Configure single sign-on with Microsoft Entra ID for agents in Microsoft Teams](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/configure-sso-teams)

The bot must support single sign-on.  
  
You need to publish the bot.  
  
Which two locations should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: Share a copy of the desktop flow with a member of internal IT.
Use the Export option in the flow to get the flow identifier and provide it to internal IT.
Send a copy of the desktop flow to a member of internal IT.
Create the desktop flow in a solution and provide it to internal IT.

What capability do virtual tables provide?

questions.question:
A company develops a canvas app.  
  
The app needs near real-time data from an accounting system located in a customer's data center.  
  
You need to implement a solution for the app.  
  
What should you create?
questions.explanation:
An on-premises data gateway provides the secure bridge between Power Apps canvas apps and data sources that are not hosted in the cloud, enabling quick access to the on-premises accounting system.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is deploying Power Apps and Power Automate.  
  
Several components have been created in Power Apps, Microsoft Dataverse, and Power Automate. The components must be moved from the development environment to the user acceptance test environment in one solution package.  
  
You need to create the solution package for promotion.  
  
Where should you create the package?

You notice that some cells show an error rather than the expected data.  
  
You need to get more information about the errors.  
  
What should you do?

questions.question:

You notice that some cells show an error rather than the expected data.

What should you do?

options.text: Add salespeople to an Office 365 security group.
Add salespeople to a security role.

questions.explanation:

Adding the salespeople to the group assigned to the sales environment grants that environment-level access while keeping nonmembers out. Security roles and their privileges control access to data and resources within an environment rather than isolating environments.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are implementing server-side synchronization for a company. The company uses Exchange Online, with no permissions delegated. Every user is assigned the **Approve Email Addresses for Users or Queues** privilege.  
  
You set up the server profile and configure the mailboxes. An issue occurs when you try to approve mailboxes for other users.

**Learn more:** [Connect to Exchange Online - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/connect-exchange-online)

A user must create a Power Apps portal app.  
  
The user receives a permission-denied error while creating the portal app.  
  
You need to configure the permissions required to create the portal app. Which three permissions should you configure? Each correct answer represents part of the solution.  
  
**NOTE:** Each correct selection is worth one point.

options.text: In the Power Platform admin center, ensure that the user account has read-write access.

In Azure Active Directory, ensure that the user has permission to register an app.
In the Power Platform admin center, change the portal app owner to the user.
In the Power Platform admin center, ensure that the user has the System administrator security role.

Creating a Power Apps portal requires a user account with Read-Write access mode and the System Administrator security role in the Power Platform environment. Azure subscription Contributor access and changing portal ownership are not creation prerequisites.

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You need to incorporate the business card solution into the check-in app.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
The AI Builder business card reader component detects business cards and extracts their information in a Power Apps canvas app. It is the prebuilt AI capability intended for adding business-card scanning to an app.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use the business card reader component in a canvas app in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/ai-builder/business-card-reader-component-in-powerapps)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You need to design the resort portal so that it meets the business requirements.  
  
Which data source should you use?
questions.explanation: Microsoft Power Pages uses Microsoft Dataverse as its native data source, supporting portal data storage, table permissions, and Power Platform integration.

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company plans to create a Power Virtual Agents bot.  
  
The bot must meet the following requirements:  
  
- It must provide the company’s address information.  
- It must be available in Microsoft Teams and on the company’s internet website.  
  
You need to configure the bot.  
  
Which component should you use?
questions.explanation:
A channel connects a Power Virtual Agents bot to the platforms where users interact with it. Channels can publish the bot to Microsoft Teams and to a website, satisfying the required deployment locations.\
\
**Learn more:** [Key concepts - Publish and deploy your agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/publication-fundamentals-publish-channels)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
A company operates a custom website.  
  
You need to embed a Power Virtual Agents chatbot on the website.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A custom web channel is the channel used to publish and embed a Power Virtual Agents chatbot in a custom website. Microsoft’s channel guidance identifies the custom website/web app channel as the website integration option, including iframe-based embedding.\
\
**Learn more:** [Key concepts - Publish and deploy your agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/publication-fundamentals-publish-channels) · [Integrate with web or native apps using Microsoft 365 Agents SDK](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/publication-integrate-web-or-native-app-m365-agents-sdk)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a Power Virtual Agents bot.  
  
You observe that the bot cannot recognize input from certain users.  
  
You need to configure the bot’s response to unrecognized user input.  
  
What are two possible ways to accomplish this goal? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
A Fallback topic is triggered for unknown intent and captures unrecognized user input. Its flow can redirect to the Escalate system topic, which transfers the conversation to a live representative.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure the system fallback topic — Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-system-fallback-topic)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company creates a canvas app.  
  
The app requires users to enter their social security number. It should display only the final four digits when a user tabs to a different column.  
  
You need to configure the app.  
  
Which option should you use?
questions.explanation:
Power Fx is the formula language for canvas apps and can implement control behavior when focus changes. Its `Right` function extracts the ending characters of a text value, allowing the app to show only the last four digits of a social security number.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/overview) · [Left, Mid, and Right functions](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/reference/function-left-mid-right)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is training an AI model with a custom table to determine package delivery time based on several key fields.  
  
The test data used to train the model is also used for every training and regression-testing scenario and is considered complete data.  
  
The trained model predicts a 2 percent variance between estimated and actual package delivery times. Executive sponsors reject the model because the actual variance is 15 percent.  
  
You need to address the sponsors’ concern. What should you do?

options.text: Replace the training data with real-world data.
Reduce the size of the data used within the model.
Increase the size of the data used with the model.
Use sample training data from Microsoft.

questions.explanation: Training and evaluating a delivery-time model on the same supposedly complete dataset can hide poor generalization. Real-world delivery data captures operational variation that the custom data omitted, enabling the model to be trained and validated against conditions it will actually encounter.

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
A company builds a Power Automate cloud flow for a Power Apps app.  
  
The cloud flow must email every active contact.  
  
You need to configure the flow.  
  
Which feature should you use?
questions.explanation:
Apply to each iterates through a collection of contacts so the email action can run once for every active contact. Microsoft Learn describes Apply to each as a loop action for processing a list of items.\
\
**Learn more:** [Use the Apply to each action to process a list of items periodically](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/apply-to-each)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Your organization prohibits using custom code for solutions.  
  
You need to create a view that all users in the organization can access.  
  
Where should you create the view?
questions.explanation:
Public views are organization-owned views that can be accessed by all app users when they are made available. They are created from a solution by opening the relevant table and selecting its **Views** area, so the view is created in the table component of a solution.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understand model-driven app views](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-views)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
Your organization prohibits using custom code for solutions.  
  
You need to create a view that all users in the organization can access.  
  
Where should you create the view?
questions.explanation:
Organization-wide public/system views are associated with Dataverse tables and can be created or edited from the table’s Views area in a solution. This supports a shared view without custom code.\
\
**Learn more:** [Create or edit a model-driven app view in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/create-edit-views)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
A company is deploying Microsoft Power Platform solutions.  
  
The company requests details about the features supported by Power Fx.  
  
You need to identify Power Fx features.  
  
What should you identify?

options.text: It uses imperative and declarative logic.
It is available for purchase through a Microsoft reseller.
It uses an undefined value for uninitialized variables.

questions.explanation:
Power Fx supports both declarative formula logic and imperative logic for behavior and state-changing actions. Microsoft documents that the same expression language is used for declarative and imperative logic.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Power Fx overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/power-platform/power-fx/overview)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You create a parent entity and a child entity. The parent entity has a 1:N relationship to the child entity.  
  
You need to ensure that, when the owner of the parent record changes, all child records are assigned to the new owner.  
  
You need to configure the relationship behavior type. What should you use?
questions.explanation:
A Parental relationship cascades actions from a parent record to its related child records, including assignment. Changing the parent record’s owner therefore reassigns all related child records to that new owner.

**Learn more:** [Configure table relationship cascading behavior (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/configure-entity-relationship-cascading-behavior) · [Create a relationship between tables by using a lookup column (Power Apps)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/data-platform-entity-lookup)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A user already has access to an existing Common Data Service database.  
  
You need to ensure the user can create canvas apps that consume data from Dataverse. You must not grant any permissions that are unnecessary.  
  
Which out-of-the-box security role should you assign to the user?
questions.explanation:
The Environment Maker role lets a user create canvas apps and associated resources in an environment. Because database access is already available, it supplies the required app-authoring capability without the broader administrative or Dataverse-customization permissions in the other roles.

**Learn more:** [Role-based security roles for Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/database-security) · [Create a canvas app using Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/data-platform-create-app-scratch)

You need to create a view that all users in the organization can access.  
  
Where should you create the view?

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
A business process flow is added to the Account table and contains three stages.  
  
You need to ensure that a workflow can run when a user finishes the last stage.  
  
Which option should you select?

options.text: Available to run: Run this workflow in the background
Available to run: As an on-demand process
Available to run: As a child process

questions.explanation:
A workflow must be available as an on-demand process to be used within a business process flow. A global on-demand workflow can be configured to run when the process is completed. Microsoft notes that an on-demand workflow placed in a business process flow can be triggered by process-completion events.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add an on-demand workflow to a business process flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/bpf-add-on-demand-workflow)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
A business process flow is added to the Account table and contains three stages.  
  
You need to ensure that a workflow can run when a user finishes the last stage.  
  
Which option should you select?

options.text: Set Run After to Has failed.

questions.explanation:
A Scope groups the dependent SharePoint actions into a single processing block. A compensating error-handling path can be configured with **Run After** set to **Has failed**, allowing it to execute during the same flow run and reverse any previously created list items. The changeset request action provides transactional grouping for Dataverse operations, not SharePoint Online list actions.

**Learn more:** [Employ robust error handling - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/guidance/coding-guidelines/error-handling) · [Use scopes to organize actions in cloud flows - Power Automate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/scopes)

questions.domain: Create apps by using Microsoft Power Apps
questions.question:
You create a new independent software vendor (ISV) solution for a Power Apps app.  
  
The Power Apps solution will be imported into multiple customer environments. Those environments will contain a wide variety of solutions and publishers.  
  
You need to prevent naming conflicts during solution import.  
  
Which element should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A solution publisher prefix namespaces the names of solution components. It helps avoid naming collisions and enables solutions from different publishers to be installed in the same environment with minimal conflicts.\
\
**Learn more:** [Solution concepts with Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/alm/solution-concepts-alm) · [Create a solution in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/create-solution)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse

The Power Apps solution will be imported into multiple customer environments. Those environments will contain a wide variety of solutions and publishers.  
  
You need to prevent naming conflicts during solution import.  
  
Which element should you configure?

a paginated report to save to Microsoft OneDrive

Which solution should be used?

options.text: Default the invitation code from the email upon logging into the portal.
Auto-populate the invitation code field on the sign in screen from the email link.
Embed the invitation code in the email link URL.
Send the customer their username and temporary password in the email link.

questions.explanation:
Embedding the invitation code in the email link URL securely associates the recipient’s registration journey with the invitation and makes the code available to the portal when the link is opened. Salesforce Sites supports using site URL expressions in email templates, and its self-registration flow can be customized to collect or process additional registration data.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company is assessing Dataverse capabilities and scenarios in which virtual tables are used.  
  
You need to identify the capabilities provided by virtual tables.  
  
Which capability do virtual tables provide?

options.text: Virtual tables can be configured for user and team ownership.
Virtual tables contain columns for Status, Created On, and Modified On by default.
Virtual tables require configuration of a data provider.

questions.explanation:
A virtual table uses a data provider to manage its operations against external data. Each virtual table type is associated with a virtual table data provider; Dataverse supplies an OData v4 provider, and custom providers can also be developed. Auditing is not supported for virtual tables.

**Learn more:** [Get started with virtual tables (entities) (Microsoft Dataverse)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/virtual-entities/get-started-ve)

questions.question:
You are developing a model-driven app. Advanced settings are enabled in the environment.  
  
A form in the app needs a custom interface.  
  
You must embed the custom interface on the form without using custom code.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Modify the model-driven app to use mobile form factor.
Modify the model-driven app to use tablet form factor.
Use the classic experience to add a canvas app.

questions.explanation:
An embedded canvas app provides a custom, low-code interface within a model-driven form. The classic form designer lets makers add a Canvas app control and create a new canvas app for that form, whereas an HTML web resource requires custom code.\
\
**Learn more:** [Add an embedded canvas app on a model-driven form](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/model-driven-apps/embedded-canvas-app-add-classic-designer)

You need to create a view that all users in the organization can access.  
  
Where should you create the view?

A public view is created and published in the Power Apps maker portal, making it available to other users in the organization without requiring custom code.\

You are developing a Power Virtual Agents chatbot that uses multiple topics.  
  
Each user interaction can reference more than one topic.  
  
You need to capture a value in an initial topic and use it in later topics.  
  
Which type of variable should you create?
questions.explanation:
Bot variables are global variables that are available to all topics in an agent during a user session, allowing a value captured in one topic to be reused by subsequent topics. Topic variables are limited to their individual topic.\
\
**Learn more:** [Work with global variables - Microsoft Copilot Studio](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-sg/microsoft-copilot-studio/authoring-variables-bot)

questions.explanation: triggerOutputs() is the Power Automate expression function designed to reference the current flow's trigger outputs independent of the trigger step's internal name, making it the syntactically valid choice over outputs('trigger'), which only works when the trigger action itself is named 'trigger'. Testing equals() against the account category code value of 2 (Standard Customer) and prepending 'Standard | ' to the account name on that match, with the else branch prepending 'Preferred | ' for the remaining case, correctly reproduces the required renaming logic for both explicitly defined category code values using valid dynamic-content references (triggerOutputs()?['body/accountcategorycode'] and triggerOutputs()?['body/name']).

questions.question:
Solution: Create a flow that includes an **Update a row** action.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A cloud flow can update a Dataverse row with the **Update a row** action, but Dataverse triggers for cloud flows run asynchronously, outside the user operation and database transaction. Synchronous real-time behavior requires a Dataverse real-time workflow, which runs immediately.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understand callback registration for Dataverse triggers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/powerautomate-callbackregistration-flow) · [Microsoft Dataverse real-time workflows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/overview-realtime-workflows)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Create a workflow with an **Update Record** step.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse workflows can update records, but background workflows run asynchronously. A workflow must be configured as a real-time workflow to run immediately and satisfy a real-time update requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Microsoft Dataverse real-time workflows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/overview-realtime-workflows)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Create a flow with an **Update item** action.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Power Automate flows triggered from Dataverse execute asynchronously, separately from the user's operation, so an update action cannot provide a real-time, synchronous Status-column update. Real-time workflows run immediately and synchronously, unlike background processing.\
\
**Learn more:** [Understand callback registration for Dataverse triggers](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/dataverse/powerautomate-callbackregistration-flow) · [Microsoft Dataverse real-time workflows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/overview-realtime-workflows)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Create a workflow with a Change Status step.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
A Change Status step can change a row’s status, but only a real-time (synchronous) workflow provides an immediate update. Background workflows run asynchronously and their execution time is not immediate, so merely creating a workflow with that step does not satisfy a real-time update requirement.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure background workflow stages and steps in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-automate/configure-workflow-steps) · [Configure real-time workflow stages and steps in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/configure-workflow-steps)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Turn on attachments for a table.  
  
Does this solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
Attachments consume Dataverse file storage and retain related metadata in Dataverse database storage, so enabling them does not minimize Dataverse storage consumption.\
\
**Learn more:** [Dataverse capacity-based storage details](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/capacity-storage)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Set up SharePoint Online integration.  
  
Does the solution achieve the goal?
questions.explanation:
SharePoint Online integration stores documents in SharePoint while allowing them to be managed from Dataverse applications, reducing the need to consume Dataverse storage for document files.\
\
**Learn more:** [SharePoint, OneNote, and OneDrive integration with Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/data-platform/sharepoint-onedrive-onenote-intro) · [Collaborate using SharePoint](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/user/collaborate-using-sharepoint)

questions.domain: Create and manage logic and process automation
questions.question:
Solution: Add a File column to a table.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Dataverse File columns store binary files in Dataverse file storage, which consumes Dataverse file capacity. Reducing relational database storage does not eliminate Dataverse storage consumption, so this approach does not satisfy a requirement to minimize it.\
\
**Learn more:** [Dataverse capacity-based storage details](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/capacity-storage) · [Use file column data in Microsoft Dataverse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/developer/data-platform/file-column-data)

questions.domain: Configure Microsoft Dataverse
questions.question:
Solution: Configure SharePoint on-premises integration.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
SharePoint on-premises integration enables document management from Dataverse-connected apps while the documents are stored on the SharePoint Server. Storing documents outside Dataverse minimizes Dataverse storage consumption.\
\
**Learn more:** [Configure server-based authentication with SharePoint on-premises](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/configure-server-based-authentication-sharepoint-on-premises) · [Set up SharePoint integration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/set-up-sharepoint-integration)

The company has enabled auditing on the Dataverse database, and its tenant has reached maximum storage capacity.  
  
You need to delete some audit data.  
  
Which three deletion options should you use? Each correct answer provides a complete solution.  
  
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.explanation:
Dataverse audit logs can be deleted for a particular record, for one or more tables, or for all logs up to and including a selected date. A date-range deletion and deletion by column are not supported audit-log deletion options.

**Learn more:** [Manage Dataverse auditing](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/manage-dataverse-auditing) · [Recover database space by deleting audit logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/recover-database-space-deleting-audit-logs)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a canvas app that lets users view, select, and purchase products. The app uses a Gallery control to show products and checkboxes that let users select products.  
  
When users select items from the product catalog, they navigate to a different screen to complete a purchase.  
  
Users must be able to clear every product selection when they click the button.  
  
You need to configure the button.  
  
What should you do?

options.text: Use the Reload(Control) formula and pass the gallery control as parameter to the Reload formula.
Use the Reset(control) formula and pass the checkbox to the formula to clear user selections.
Set the OnCheck value to populate a collection and the OnUncheck value to remove the item from the collection. Clear the collection when the user selects the button.
Use the Revert(Products) formula and pass the checkbox to the formula to clear user selections.
Use the Reset(Control) formula and pass the gallery control as a parameter to the Reset formula.

questions.explanation:
Controls contained in a Gallery cannot be reset from outside the Gallery, and resetting a Gallery does not recursively reset its child controls. Track selected products in a collection by adding items in `OnCheck` and removing them in `OnUncheck`; clearing that collection from the button clears the selection state for all product items.

**Learn more:** [Reset function - Power Platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/power-fx/reference/function-reset) · [Gallery control in Power Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/maker/canvas-apps/controls/control-gallery)

A new table must be created to support a new app feature. Records in the table must be associated with a business unit and specify security roles for that business unit.  
  
You need to configure the table ownership.  
  
Which table ownership type should you use?
questions.explanation:
Business-owned tables store records as belonging to a business unit, enabling access to be controlled at the business-unit level through security roles. Microsoft Dataverse documents the Business ownership type as data that belongs to the business unit and can be controlled at that level.\

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],A company uses model-driven apps. Users in the sales department enter the first name, last name, and phone number of customers in the app. The users request a single screen in the app to enter the customer data.  
  
You need to configure the app.  
  
What should you do?
questions.explanation:
Canvas apps let makers design a fully custom, single-screen layout containing only the specific fields needed—in this case first name, last name, and phone number. This canvas app can be embedded into the model-driven app (for example, on a form or via a custom page) so sales users get one consolidated screen for data entry instead of navigating a standard multi-section model-driven form. Power Automate flows handle automation, not user interfaces; Copilot Studio builds conversational agents, not data entry screens; and modifying the site map only changes navigation, not the layout of a data entry screen.

Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Changing a Microsoft 365 user name updates the existing user principal name for the same Microsoft Entra identity. Power Platform synchronizes Microsoft 365 user information to the Dataverse SystemUser record, which is associated with the Microsoft Entra Object ID; changing the sign-in name does not create a new user record or remove its existing history.\
\

questions.question:
Solution: Delete the user account in the Power Platform admin portal, then recreate the account using the new name.  
  
Does this solution meet the goal?
questions.explanation:
Deleting a Microsoft Entra user removes that user object from active use; recreating it produces a separate identity. Dataverse records and audit entries are associated with the original user, so deleting and recreating the account does not preserve the user’s application history. The existing user’s sign-in name (UPN) should be updated instead.\
\
**Learn more:** [Plan and troubleshoot UserPrincipalName changes in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/hybrid/connect/howto-troubleshoot-upn-changes) · [Recover from deletions in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/architecture/recover-from-deletions)

Dataverse duplicate detection rules can be set to run at different times: when a record is created, when a record is updated, or during data import.
